_sequence.reply: [Sample] I've heard 'single source of truth' before. What will this cost, and what do I get before the next board meeting?
Fine, but my teams already spend days reconciling. Who does the extra work while you build this?
And when the department heads disagree on a definition – which they will – who decides?
If I have the final say on definitions and the cost is capped, I can take this to the board. Send me the phased plan by Friday.
